name: recruitflow
description: RecruitFlow — Premium AI-Powered Recruitment Management System & Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
author: RecruitFlow Engineering

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "API,WEB,WORKER" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --workspace=@recruitflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@recruitflow/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@recruitflow/worker"
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/types && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/validation && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/api && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/worker && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/types && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@recruitflow/validation
